digest.component_or_area: AWS MCP environment - Jira bridge integration
propositions: Deployed MCP server lacks Jira credentials (JIRA_URL, JIRA_USER, JIRA_API_TOKEN) required by bridge_check_access, causing all bridge operations to fail with exit code 2.

Four SSM parameters (three operator-seeded, one terraform-managed) must be declared in ssm.tf with type split (String for URL/user/project, SecureString for token) and adopted via import blocks to avoid ParameterAlreadyExists collision.
Jira credentials must reach the MCP container via .env file in both compose and blue-green mcp_run_new paths, validated by extending _ENV_FILE_ONLY parity test to prevent re-spelling as -e flags.

Absent or blank Jira credentials must degrade softly (container boots, endpoint serves, bridge tools report unavailable) rather than abort fetch-secrets.sh and block deploys, because Jira is an outbound integration not an auth boundary.
JIRA_PROJECT environment variable must also be wired, as access_check._resolve_probe_scope fails closed with missing_project when unset and only reads environment, not rebar.toml.
